provenance.method: Blind four-way grading of the 12 live-pool comparison questions (B01-B12): per question the systems were shown as system_A..D in a seeded random order; one grader agent graded all four against the verified gold answer, gold sources and traps, and an independent skeptic agent re-checked every grade and could change it (none changed).
